crossRefs.note: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

translations.web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
translations.bsb: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
translations.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
translations.asv: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever.
